Tek bir rakip, kolay bir bot. İşçilerini: One rival, an easy bot. Put your workers to work, then into armour: every soldier is a worker lost. Bring the rival's castle down.
Önce çiftçi ve oduncu, sonra demirci. Or: Farmers and woodcutters first, then the smith. Attack when your army is bigger than theirs.
Sis her şeyi saklar. Gözcü gönder, rapor: Fog hides everything. Send scouts, read their reports and build your army to match the rival's. Attacking blind is the shortest way to lose.
Rapor yaklaşıktır (yaklaşık ±%20). Birde: A report is approximate (about ±20%). Gather more than one.
Bir rakibe ulakla altın ya da erzak yoll: Send a rival gold or food by envoy: a bot that receives a gift leaves you alone for a while. Do not fight two enemies at once; keep one busy.
Ulak yakalanmaz ve iz bırakmaz. Mesajına: An envoy cannot be caught and leaves no trail. Whatever you write, the rival cannot know the truth.
Ormanda köyler, haydut kampları ve sandı: The forest holds villages, bandit camps and chests. Explore it with a scout, plunder villages with your cavalry and clear the camps. The loot feeds your army.
Köy yağmalamak için en az 3 asker gereki: Plundering a village takes at least 3 soldiers. Whoever reaches a chest first takes it.
Gölge Krallığı: rakibe gerçekten yürüyen: The Shadow Kingdom: send a phantom army that really marches but fades when it fights, and write a false army table. Your rivals will think you stronger than you are.
Hayalet ordu altın harcar, asker harcama: A phantom costs gold, not soldiers. A rival's scout reads the false table.
Tüccar Cumhuriyeti: yaklaşan düşman ordu: The Merchant Republic: bribe some of an approaching enemy army, then hire a bandit camp you have found and send it at a rival.
Rüşvet için ordunun sana yaklaşırken gör: To bribe, the army must be in your sight on its way to you. Find the camp first.
Kâhinler herkesin krallığını ve destesin: The Oracle knows every kingdom and deck and sees the odds of a fight. The knowledge is yours: enter only the battles you will win.
Kazanma aralığı geniş ya da düşükse sald: If the range of the odds is low or wide, hold back. You see tricks (phantoms, disguises) marked as such.
Entrikacılar: ordunu başka bir oyuncunun: The Schemers: send your army in another player's colour, and a false envoy. While your rivals blame each other, you clear the road to the castle.
Disguise has a cooldown. The truth comes out some time after the first battle, or through a scout report.
Krallığının gücünü kullan, rakiplerin kr: Use your kingdom's power and guess your rivals' kingdoms.
